goldenStory.title: Password reset via email link
goldenStory.summary: A signed-out user requests a reset, receives an email link, and sets a new password. Touches the sign-in UI, an API endpoint, email delivery, and the user store.
goldenStory.body:
As a signed-out user, I want to reset my password via an emailed link, so that I can regain access without contacting support.

Acceptance Tests:
1. Given I'm on the sign-in screen When I request a reset for my registered email Then I'm told a reset link has been sent.
2. Given I open a valid, unexpired reset link When I submit a new password Then my password is changed and I can sign in with it.
3. Given I open an expired or already-used reset link When the page loads Then I'm told the link is no longer valid and offered a new one.
4. Given I request a reset for an email that isn't registered Then I see the same confirmation (no account enumeration).
